subject: Kickoff: evaluation roadmap & GRC points of contact
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Eli Turner <eli.turner@bluelattice.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: evaluation roadmap & GRC points of contact

Hi Eli —

Thanks again for taking time to evaluate Redwood Inference. To keep things moving toward a tight proof/close window, we'd like to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on: scope for SOC 2 evidence, data handling/contact owners, and a timeline for the eval and procurement checkpoints.

Proposed immediate outcomes:
- Confirm primary GRC/security contact(s) at BlueLattice
- Agree on SOC 2 scope and evidence delivery cadence
- Lock a 30-minute kickoff to align stakeholders and milestone dates (we're targeting a 4-week evaluation cadence)

I've attached a lightweight MAP spreadsheet and a SOC 2 evidence matrix template to speed the mapping exercise. Suggest Wed, May 19 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute alignment call — if that doesn't work, send a couple of options and we'll adapt.

Quick notes on roles from our side:
- Neha (me): MAP facilitation, scheduling, and tech Qs
- Karthik: security escalation and technical compliance details
- Marissa: evidence collection and timeline owner
- Jonas: deployment prerequisites and environment checklist

Eli — could you please confirm who on your side will be the GRC lead (SOC 2 evidence owner) and a data handling contact? Once we have that, we'll populate the MAP and circulate next steps.

Thanks,

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet) | SOC2_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Eli Turner <eli.turner@bluelattice.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluelattice.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evaluation roadmap & GRC points of contact

Neha —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Appreciate the compact timeline. I'm looping in our security alias and introducing our lead:

Lena Morris <lena.morris@bluelattice.com> — Head of Security, BlueLattice (primary SOC 2 evidence owner)

Lena and the security team will want to understand:
- Confirmed scope (production vs. test, PII in scope, retention windows)
- Data residency constraints and any controlled access rules for KVs/keys
- Any required attestations or vendor questionnaires beyond SOC 2

Wed, May 19 at 10:00 AM PT works for a brief kickoff for us. Lena — can you confirm availability? 

Thanks,
Eli Turner
Director, Partnerships | BlueLattice
eli.turner@bluelattice.com | (617) 555-0134

Eli / Lena / Neha —

Thanks for the quick reply and for introducing Lena. For clarity on ownership from our side:

- Karthik Iyer (security escalation & compliance liaison) — will be the primary contact for SOC 2 control mappings and technical evidence requests
- Marissa Cole (MAP & evidence timeline owner) — will coordinate evidence collection and chase outstanding items with your owners
- Jonas Weber (deployment lead) — will cover VPC/networking, key management integration, and any infrastructure prerequisites

I've populated the attached MAP_v0.1.xlsx with our proposed milestones and the SOC2_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx with the first-pass list of artifacts we typically request. Please review and add your owners in the highlighted column.

Call details (proposed):
- Wed May 19, 2027 — 10:00 AM PT (30 minutes)
- Join: https://meet.redwood.com/j/8042 (placeholder)

If you prefer, we can split the kickoff into two short sessions — 1) GRC scoping with Lena & team and 2) deployment/infra with Jonas — but given the overlap on evidence and timelines, a single 30-minute alignment should be most efficient.

Looking forward to getting this into the MAP and starting the evidence cadence.

Regards,

Karthik Iyer
Head of Applied Security | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_v0.1.xlsx (see owners tab) | SOC2_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx

Thanks all —

Confirming Wed, May 19 at 10:00 AM PT for the kickoff. I will be the primary SOC 2 evidence owner on the BlueLattice side; our evidence lead (ops) will join if we need to walk samples. A couple quick asks ahead of the call so we can prioritize:

1) Please add a column in the MAP for "evidence owner (BL)" — we'll populate that during the call
2) Call out any items that require privileged access (e.g., logs, KMS attestations) so we can prepare appropriate access forms
3) Any EHR/PII handling specifics or special retention settings — share examples if possible

I'll review the two attachments Karthik attached and add initial owners before the meeting. See you Wednesday.

Best,

Lena Morris
Head of Security | BlueLattice
lena.morris@bluelattice.com | (617) 555-0202
